title: ZXSpace Leaderboards
seoTitle: ZXSpace Leaderboards | Game Center High Scores | BarkinMad Studios
description: Compete on the ZXSpace Game Center leaderboards, improve your high score, earn achievements and compare your performance with players around the world.
summary: Every game is an opportunity to achieve a new personal best and climb the global Game Center leaderboards.

sections.heading: Compete Against Players Worldwide
paragraphs: ZXSpace supports Apple Game Center leaderboards, allowing you to compare your highest scores with players from around the world. Every completed game gives you another opportunity to improve your ranking and set a new personal best.
Whether you're aiming for the top position or simply trying to beat your previous score, every wave contributes towards your long-term progress.

sections.heading: Game Center Leaderboards
paragraphs: Your highest score is automatically submitted to Apple Game Center when you're signed in. The longer you survive, the more alien waves you complete and the more enemies you destroy, the higher your score will be.
ZXSpace also contributes towards the shared ZX Series Total Score leaderboard, allowing players to compare their combined performance across supported ZX Series games.
bullets: Shared ZX Series Total Score leaderboard.

sections.heading: How to Earn Higher Scores
paragraphs: Scoring well in ZXSpace requires more than simply surviving. Efficiently destroying enemies, protecting your cities and making smart decisions throughout every wave all contribute to higher scores.
Longer games naturally provide more scoring opportunities, but balancing risk and survival is essential.

sections.heading: Improve Your Ranking
paragraphs: The highest-ranking players combine quick reactions with careful planning. Learning enemy movement patterns, positioning your cannon efficiently and surviving difficult waves will naturally improve your leaderboard position.
Every game provides valuable experience, helping you recognise attack patterns and react more effectively during later waves.

sections.heading: Beat Your Personal Best
paragraphs: The most satisfying competition is often against yourself. Every improvement in your positioning, timing and survival skills helps you achieve a higher personal best.
As your skills improve you'll also unlock achievements, earn more BarkinMad Coins and progress further through the game.

images.caption: Every completed game is another opportunity to climb the global leaderboards.

faq.question: Does ZXSpace support Game Center leaderboards?
faq.answer: Yes. ZXSpace automatically submits your highest score to Apple Game Center when you're signed in.

faq.question: Can I improve my leaderboard position?
faq.answer: Yes. Every new personal best replaces your previous highest score on the leaderboard.

faq.question: How do I achieve a higher score?
faq.answer: Survive longer, complete more waves, destroy bonus UFOs, protect your cities and use power-ups effectively.

faq.question: Does ZXSpace contribute to shared ZX Series leaderboards?
faq.answer: Yes. Your progress also contributes to the shared ZX Series Total Score leaderboard across supported ZX Series games.
